energy.covariance: Not propagated; displayed species uncertainties are correlated.
energy.fresh_table: C/O/CO gas entries confirmed in rendered official 1.172 table.

four_th_plus.inspection: Full author-hosted accepted manuscript, 19 pages, especially Sections 2.2/3.1/3.3 and Eq 13. File says ORIGINAL UNEDITED MANUSCRIPT; final publisher PDF not substituted.
four_th_plus.spin_orbit: Not included; neighbouring triplets omitted. Eight ab initio potential curves do not mean eight states in the distributed list.
four_th_plus.common_ancestry: Coxon-Hajigeorgiou ground potential also underlies Li2015; MARVEL replacements refine measured levels.

li2015.inspection: Publisher-rendered abstract and Section 4 methods; original PDF not retrieved. Official complete distributed states/PF downloaded.
li2015.method: Ground-state Coxon-Hajigeorgiou potential, LEVEL calculations; paper describes PF summed to dissociation and published independently of transition subset.
li2015.partition_dependence: Official PF and distributed states differ by 6.5-11.0 ppm, more than Q output rounding alone. Temperature half-digit sensitivity could encompass it, but cannot explain it if the declared integer-K grid is exact; generation details remain unresolved.

thermodynamic_sources.janaf_CO: C-093, September 1965; direct published Cp table, not a spectral-intensity inference.
thermodynamic_sources.NASA_CO: Gurvich 1979 pt1 p25 pt2 p29 header; monograph not inspected.
thermodynamic_sources.BC2016: 10.1051/0004-6361/201526961; frozen primary CDS molecular Q table; molecular spin-orbit omitted by general BC procedure.

decision.reason: Full available state moments and direct thermodynamic tables support the existing thermal curve on sampled 1500-4000 K; the independently balanced energy anchor is unchanged.
limitations: Representative-isotope internal partition with natural elemental translation is an approximation, not exact natural-isotope equilibrium.
Two-state 4thplus list is not complete over all electronic states; tail sensitivities are not a full uncertainty bound.
Spectral-intensity improvements and UV fluorescence are not evidence for an equilibrium abundance correction.
Metadata/PF grid and upper-energy discrepancies are preserved explicitly.
